slice: G2 typed safe Gallery read API over canonical Design Packages

repository.scope: The G2 implementation already exists on main (landed with commit f2a5074); this artifact records its acceptance evidence. Every G2 file below is hash-pinned at the release-gate commit, and this evidence document is the only source-tree change on top of it.

focused_gate.command: env -u AGENT_COMMONS_STATE_ROOT -u AGENT_COMMONS_SESSION_ID uv run --locked python -m pytest -q tests/ui/test_gallery_read.py tests/ui/test_react_gallery.py tests/ui/test_artifact_preview.py tests/services/test_artifact_content.py tests/services/test_design_packages.py

assertions: GET /api/gallery and /api/gallery/{design_package_id} return only the typed agent_commons.gallery.v1 wire DTO built from canonical Design Package records; screens are deterministically ordered with exact artifact/task revisions, sha256 content revisions and enforced producer provenance.

Empty, loading, ready, stale and error states are explicit typed states; projection, reader and route failures collapse to closed refusal codes without exception text, raw filesystem paths, manifest bodies or provider data.

Preview eligibility is re-verified per screen through the existing hardened ArtifactPreviewReader: manifest-authorized descriptor-relative O_NOFOLLOW access, exact SHA-256 and size proof, PNG/JPEG only, 10 MiB byte and 16 MP pixel caps; changed, symlinked, unauthorized or unverifiable sources fail closed to stale/unavailable.

Every response carries Cache-Control: no-store and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff via route headers plus the global security-header middleware; /api/gallery data routes stay behind the browser-session dependency while only the shell and hashed assets are public.
Bounded reads refuse instead of silently truncating (64 packages / 64 screens); malformed identifiers and unpublished packages receive typed 400/404 refusals.

The React Gallery consumes only the typed DTO over the cookie-session API base; its EN/RU string table is paired with identical key sets and contains no demo copy; no demo data, arbitrary artifact paths or SVG/HTML previews exist in the G2 surface.

safety.provider_data: No prompt, transcript, raw provider output, credentials or environment values are recorded.
safety.canonical_truth: This artifact is evidence only; Design Package, task and review truth remains in the immutable ledger.
